verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own docs say it caps each employee's spend with card controls and custom limits, and lets admins adjust limits instantly and embed expense policies into the card program. Its MCP tooling can update individual cards' spending limits and reset intervals, which supports per-card limits, alongside role and permission customization. Missing for 10: detail on which granular controls exist beyond amount limits and intervals (e.g. merchant or category restrictions), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
